headline: Flaky CI tests nobody owns
summary: Teams rerun failing tests until they pass. Nobody knows which tests are flaky or who should fix them.
who: Small engineering teams without a platform engineer
quote: Half our CI time is rerunning flaky tests.

competition.label: Medium
competition.reason: A few tools exist, mostly for big teams

difficulty.label: Medium
difficulty.reason: Needs CI integrations to be useful

aiSuggestions.title: Owner tagging
aiSuggestions.text: Assign each flaky test to whoever last touched it.

aiSuggestions.title: Waste report
aiSuggestions.text: A weekly email of minutes lost to reruns.

aiSuggestions.title: Auto-quarantine
aiSuggestions.text: Skip known-flaky tests so merges stop blocking.

headline: Pet medication prices are impossible to compare
summary: Owners pay very different prices for the same prescription. There is no simple way to compare pharmacies or track refills.
who: Pet owners with animals on long-term medication
quote: I still can’t tell which pharmacy is cheapest.

competition.label: Medium
competition.reason: Coupon sites exist, no clear tracker

difficulty.label: Low
difficulty.reason: Price data and reminders are simple to start

aiSuggestions.title: Price tracker
aiSuggestions.text: Compare one prescription across pharmacies.

aiSuggestions.title: Refill reminders
aiSuggestions.text: Ping owners before a refill runs out.

sources.title: Search Hacker News: pet medication prices

headline: Renters can’t dispute deposit deductions
summary: Landlords keep part of the deposit with vague reasons. Renters lack the photos and paperwork to push back.
who: Renters moving out of an apartment
quote: They kept $600 and I had no move-in photos.

competition.label: Low
competition.reason: Few tools focus on move-out disputes

difficulty.label: Low
difficulty.reason: A guided photo checklist is a small app

aiSuggestions.title: Move-in kit
aiSuggestions.text: A timestamped room-by-room photo checklist.

aiSuggestions.title: Dispute letter
aiSuggestions.text: Generate a letter citing local deposit rules.

headline: Decisions get lost after meetings
summary: Teams agree on something in a call, then nobody can find what was decided. The same debate happens again a week later.
who: Remote teams with many recurring meetings
quote: We re-decide the same thing every sprint.

aiSuggestions.title: Decision log
aiSuggestions.text: Pull only decisions, not full notes, into one list.

aiSuggestions.title: Re-debate alert
aiSuggestions.text: Flag when a topic was already decided.

headline: New laptops take days to set up for dev work
summary: Every new hire or new machine means days of installing tools and fixing versions. Setup docs are always out of date.
who: Developers joining a team or switching machines
quote: Onboarding docs were wrong in five places.

competition.label: Medium
competition.reason: Dev containers and scripts partly solve it

difficulty.label: Medium
difficulty.reason: Many operating systems and stacks to cover

aiSuggestions.title: Setup recorder
aiSuggestions.text: Record a working machine and replay it on a new one.

aiSuggestions.title: Docs checker
aiSuggestions.text: Run setup docs in CI so they never go stale.

headline: Receipts scattered across email at tax time
summary: Freelancers hunt through inboxes for receipts every spring. Missing ones mean lost deductions.
quote: I spend a whole weekend digging up receipts.

competition.label: Medium
competition.reason: Expense apps exist but need manual work

difficulty.label: Medium
difficulty.reason: Email access and parsing are the hard part

aiSuggestions.title: Inbox sweep
aiSuggestions.text: Find every receipt in email and tag it by category.

aiSuggestions.title: Missing check
aiSuggestions.text: Spot recurring charges with no receipt.

headline: Sleep trackers give numbers nobody can act on
summary: People collect months of sleep data but don’t know what to change. The scores feel arbitrary.
who: People who wear a sleep or fitness tracker
quote: Great, a score of 72. Now what?

difficulty.label: Medium
difficulty.reason: Needs data exports from several devices

aiSuggestions.title: One-change coach
aiSuggestions.text: Suggest one experiment per week and measure it.

headline: Contractor quotes that don’t match the work
summary: Homeowners get quotes that are hard to compare and grow once work starts. They can’t tell a fair price from padding.
who: Homeowners planning a repair or renovation
quote: The final bill was double the quote.

competition.label: Medium
competition.reason: Marketplaces exist, few compare line items

difficulty.label: Medium
difficulty.reason: Needs local price data to be trusted

aiSuggestions.title: Quote checker
aiSuggestions.text: Upload a quote, see line items that look high.

aiSuggestions.title: Change-order log
aiSuggestions.text: Track every price change with a signature.

headline: Research gets lost in 80 open tabs
summary: People keep tabs open as a to-do list and lose them in a crash. Bookmarks become a graveyard nobody reads.
quote: My browser is my to-do list and it crashed.

difficulty.label: Low
difficulty.reason: A browser extension is a small first step

aiSuggestions.title: Tab to task
aiSuggestions.text: Turn a tab into a task with a reason to return.

aiSuggestions.title: Weekly sweep
aiSuggestions.text: Close stale tabs and summarize what was in them.

sources.title: Search Hacker News: too many tabs

headline: Freelancers chase late invoices for weeks
summary: Clients pay 30 to 60 days late and freelancers feel awkward following up. Cash flow suffers.
quote: I hate sending the third payment reminder.

difficulty.label: Low
difficulty.reason: Email sequences are simple to build

aiSuggestions.title: Polite autopilot
aiSuggestions.text: Escalating reminders in the freelancer’s own tone.

aiSuggestions.title: Late-payer score
aiSuggestions.text: Warn before taking work from slow payers.
